item.title: HarnessTax: The Harness Matters Less Than You Think
item.description: The HarnessTax study from UC Berkeley and Arena evaluates 21 model-harness pairings and reaches three surprising conclusions. They back up with data why I use pi and OpenCode daily.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: What is Pi? — The Minimal Coding Agent That Went Viral
item.description: Pi is a minimal terminal coding agent. This article explains what it is, how it differs from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI, and why it went viral.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: Crit: The Review Loop for Agents
item.description: Crit is a tool designed to close the code review loop for AI-generated code, providing an intuitive and efficient web interface.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro
